title: cleome tenuis subsp. humilis
intro: Cleome tenuis subsp. humilis, commonly known as the 'Desert Hyacinth', is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Cleomaceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleome tenuis subsp. humilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, combat infections, and exhibit expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
